_about: Reference low beams, digitized BY EYE from isocandela plots Anya shared 10-09 (Hoffman goniometer printouts, a Lextar contour map). Each contour: [left, right, bottom] in degrees (spec frame, + = right / up); the top hugs the cut-off. Error bar ~±2°. Lextar levels are fractions of its ~58 kcd peak; its flux is ESTIMATED from the contours (~1.7k lm above 1160 cd), not printed.

bosch-de-h1.verdict: early halogen projector; 'we have it beat for the most part' (Anya)
bosch-de-h1.size: projector, lens ~60-66 mm (2.4-2.6in): measured off a photo of the 5.75in housing (lens ~235 px of ~550 px bezel) ≈ 62 mm; Gemini/TheRetrofitSource say 2.6in. Plain ellipsoid reflector (Anya).

_shape_only: Koito BiLED (aced IIHS early; no scale on the shots): flat top on the left, 15° step up on the right, hottest part right of centre hugging the line, high-level band about as wide as the image's middle half, wide shallow low-level wings. MLED 2.0 (fails 3.5L 0.86D, no sign uplight; Anya: strong modern design): facet groups T1 hotspot, T2 wide flood, B1/B2 hotspot, B3 hot horizontal strip; flat batwing/trapezoid flood.
_sizes: Anya 10-09: Marchal, both Cibies, Hella H4 = 7in round; Hella bifocal = 5.75in; the LED projectors (Lextar, Koito, Jeep JL, MLED 2.0) = 90 mm OD lenses; Bosch DE possibly 2.5in. liou's FMVSS lens is Ø88 (f 84) — same aperture class as the LED projectors.
